notes.title: UPDATE 2.47: GRAPHIC RESEARCH
notes.content:
They're short, ill tempered, bearded and aren't afraid of anything. They're the Stubbyobs. These perennially ill-humored warriors are coming to to the World of Twelve. Do you think everything that's small is cute? You're in for a surprise! But first, check out the exclusive graphic research that has given life to these eternally unsatisfied creatures...

Up till now, the Stubbyobs have kept a low profile. To the point that Twelvians had totally forgot they existed. But recently, these surly warriors have poked their noses outside their underground tunnels to come and wreak havoc in the World of Twelve.

Before you find them in game, check out two pages of exclusive graphic research!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/279551569457d681f777f320ebcd9d6b12488e28.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/0c6dd1e6d262a04aea5f945d8dadab9b80703ea1.jpg

The suspended chariots will certainly evoke the famous scene of the foundry and Smaug the Golden Dragon in The Hobbit by Peter Jackson.

Just because they're half as big as a common Twelvian doesn't mean the Stubbyobs have an appetite for tofu! Thus, the never-ending banquets play an important role in their daily lives. Once they've filled their bellies, they're (a little) less grumpy and have all the strength they need to face their enemies!

notes.title: Update 2.46:
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/7d78d3c024ccc5d1dd70ccfe857e4d66010a0297.png

ASTRUB REDESIGN

The mercenary city of Astrub has undergone an extreme makeover! The destruction of the class statues has given rise to the creation of the Divine Temple, which welcomes all young souls coming from Incarnam, whatever their affiliation.

The Old Town is more urban and includes all the frequently visited elements: the Militia Tower, the Bank, the Sellrooms, Zaap etc.
The suburbs, on the city outskirts, host the workshops and other points of interest.

The monsters in Astrub and its surroundings are rebalanced. A new monster family can be found in the brand new Astrub's Quarry: the Rotceres. It is rumoured that they would build something incredible in the depths of the earth ... but no one really knows what.

The limits of the area reserved for non-subscribed players have been slightly pushed back, allowing them to now access Tainela, Astrub’s Rocky Inlet and Cemetery.

IMPROVEMENT TO HARVESTING PROFESSIONS

The progression for harvesting professions is improved by doubling the experience gained during the harvests, to accelerate access to a larger number of harvestable resources.

The probability of obtaining resources from monsters has been increased (mainly at low and medium level), in order to reduce the number of fights needed to make a piece of equipment.
 
MERGER OF THE MARKETPLACES

The marketplaces are merged and classified into 3 categories: resources / consumables / equipment.
 

OBJECT ENCYCLOPEDIA

To facilitate access to information that until now was only visible on our website, the encyclopedia makes its way ingame.

In addition to the bestiary, you will find new tabs: equipment, consumables and resources.

New filters will allow you to refine your search, making it more dynamic.
 

ENSEMBLE CREATION

Ensemble pages replace the custom set system so that it not only takes equipment into account, but also characteristic points and spell variants.
 

UNLIMITED MAGICAL ORB INCLUDED IN THE SUBSCRIPTION


Surprise! As we want to make you happy, we decided to bring forward to today the arrival of the Magical Orb in the subscription!

Thanks to the Magical Orb included in the subscription:

You will have more flexibility ingame, both in PvM and PvP. The possibility of changing one’s characteristics during the placement period will be added a little later.

We have thought of everything: as soon as the 2.46 update is released, the ensemble system will be available. It has been built to give you more autonomy and to help you better organize your characteristics and equipment.

notes.title: Update 2.45: Now Live!
notes.content:
Starting today, you'll be setting off to take on the Towers of the Forgotten! With 375 new spells up your sleeve, you'll have the opportunity to test out new skills in combat. And if you've already reached level 200, the Omega levels will reach out to you!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/2ef96d9bb83925bda5d3ab630b706d69f0bcfc4a.png


For those of you who are ready to do battle, here's some valuable information regarding the arrival of spell variants:

All characters' characteristics will be reset to zero.
To really make the most of the arrival of spell variants, we are offering the Magical Orb service, unrestricted, for six days. In other words, until 10:00 (Paris Time) on Monday, December 11, you will be able to practice by changing these characteristics as much as you like.
Your spell points will disappear. In exchange, those earned using spell scrolls will be added as Kolossokens, at a rate of 1,000 Kolossokens per spell point. 
Your unused spell scrolls will also give you 1,000 Kolossokens once you've used them.
That's perfect timing, because the Kolossoken Shop is going to be enlarged, offering new items!


For those of you who still don't know what's in store, head to the Update 2.45 page.


DISCOVER UPDATE 2.45

notes.title: Update 2.43 is online!
notes.content:
"Ilyzaelle and the Ivory Dofus": this update's title says it all! Well, not literally "all". Because even though the new boss and the quest for the Ivory Dofus – the first Primordial Dofus introduced in the game since… 2008?! – are definitely the main attraction, you'll have plenty of other things to do too.
https://s.ankama.com/www/static.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/09/04/751953.jpg
Big things, in fact – starting with the end of the alignment quests. Ten years of trudging hither and yon have finally reached their conclusion, with new types of rewards.

Ten new Wanted Monsters are also in the mix, from level 20 to level 200, while Ilyzaelle and her Soul-Blaze minions will be doing their best to take you down. But here, too, the rewards will be well worth the effort!

So how's that for "big things"? But of course, we've got something even bigger for you: the Ivory Dofus! The fifth Primordial Dofus has joined the party, so you'd better get ready to dance! You won't find it just hanging out under the hooves of a Dragoturkey! Also, please note that if you find it before December 5th, you will be entered into a random drawing for a chance to win amazing prizes (more information here)! But enough chitchat. You've had the chance to learn more about the Ivory Dofus in recent news items, and the most important info is right here on the update page!

And let's not forget all the extras revealed by Korri and Halden in Gamakna #3: read it online or download it for free from the App Store, Google Play, or the Windows Store.

notes.title: Update 2.42: It's Online!
notes.content:
Here we go: workers across the World of Twelve have dropped their shovels, picks, and dragon-powered jackhammers, because Route 666 is finally opening up to all you gutsy adventurers out there! The Sidimote Moors have been given a complete, up-to-date makeover, and are waiting for you! Well? What are you waiting for to go there?!

 http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/06/20/710432.jpg

Linking the Howling Heights to Brakmar, Route 666 will take you on a comprehensive tour of the region. But it won't be a walk in the park, that's for sure! 


The main evils that'll hit you in the face (or stab you in the back) about this Sidimote Moors revamp are the dangers and dungeons! Because, as well as the new and increasingly formidable monster families waiting for you, there are two brand new dungeons that will guarantee you a blood rush with an extra side of blood. All hail the Riktus Bandits' and Ghouls' dungeons! 


For more information, you can find the devblogs and articles all about this update here.

notes.title: Update 2.41: Preliminary Graphics
notes.content:
Update 2.41 is nearly here and all we can say is, it’s going to blow you away! Summer is still a long way off, but pull out your shades cos’ you’re gonna need ‘em! Check out two exclusive sketches of the new zone right now: Mishell Island.

 
http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/03/15/660701.jpg

Mishell is a young Osamodas devoted to animal rights who is giving her all to protect every animal species in the world, which she shelters on her island. So don’t fall for that puckish, naive look! It will be thanks to her alone if your great, great, great grandchildren ever get to see a Plain Pikoko or a Royal Pingwin.


This pure and innocent soul spends her time gathering up the eggs of every species and keeps them safe on an ark, remind you of something...?

 
http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/dofus/www/03_2017/arca-de-noe-a-colorear.jpg

Noah’s Ark: that’s the major theme for this zone!


The new update is going to cast a cheerful rainbow over the World of Twelve and there’s a strong chance that the creatures also come in a dizzying array of colors...

 
http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/dofus/www/03_2017/coqueline-pl1-ile.png

Behind the good vibes and fluffy backgrounds – as if an army of multi-colored blops just regurgitated their last meal – lies the darker side of Mishell Island.

 
http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/dofus/www/03_2017/coqueline-pl2-chasseurs.png

In contrast to our young Osamodas, who strives to protect all of the Krosmic fauna and flora, the hunters are hell-bent on destruction and devoid of compassion and scruples.


That’s right, the dramatic contrast between the devotion of one and the obsession with dumb trophies of the other, can only mean one thing: Mishell isn’t out of the sands yet!


Visit us in April to explore this new zone!

notes.title: Got the Luck of the Oirish? Scratch Quick!
notes.content:
The Pandawa goddess must have stolen the idea from Ecaflip: a game of chance to celebrate her special day. Or maybe it is was inspired by her Ouginak fleabag because this is a scratching game! Whatever the cause: Quick Potrick is available until March 20th and there are a few choice gifts to win!

 
http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/03/16/661211.jpg

Quick Potrick is quick and simple! You just have to be subscribed and visit this link! Once you get there, just scratch as if your life depended on it!


So what’s all the fuss about? You can win one of the gifts below:

 

	Praline Shigekax
	Almond Shigekax
	Oirish Tailcoat
	Tipsy Top Hat
	Green Piwin


To be on the safe side, find a four-leafed plant first for luck and to appease the goddess, then scratch! You can play 2 times every day until Monday, March 20th (23:59 Paris Time)!



On a side-note, please be aware that our green-garbed friends the Leprechauns will be spawning in game starting today. They will vanish at midnight on March 20th, so hunt them down and steal their gold while you can!

notes.title: Update 2.40: Naughty Dogs
notes.content:
The next update will be scratching at your door on Valentine’s Day. So it’s perhaps not just a coincidence that the big news in 2.40 is the arrival of a new character class who won’t inspire feelings of love in your heart... more like RAGE! 
 
https://static.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2017/02/09/636837.jpg

The next DOFUS update will take place on Tuesday, February 14th.

Main content:
 	The Ouginaks, the 18th character class!	The revaluation of the Dofus 
Go to the update page!

 The Ouginaks
Caught a whiff of something? Ready to hunt down your prey, sneaking closer and closer, ‘til you’re right up behind ‘em, they won’t even see it coming as you... pounce! Poor innocent creature! Foaming at the mouth, courage in your heart and rage in your belly, all of you furry barbarians will immediately identify with this new class of characters: the Ouginaks.

While you’re gnawing on that tidbit, we dug up two more Bony Montanas for you:
 	The Ouginaks Devblog	The background news The revaluation of Dofus
In the 2.40 update, we decided to improve the bonuses for the eight Dofus to make them more competitive in relation to trophies. To learn more, please read the devblog.

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Ankama wishes everyone reading this an absolutely perfect 2017! Oh yes! To be as successful as possible over 365 days, you'll need willpower, hope and... gifts! That's why, complete with our best wishes for the new year, we're giving you a code to use until 11AM (Paris Time) on January 3rd!

 
http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2016/12/28/612565.jpg

You might still be suffering from copious amounts of turkey, brussels sprouts and jingle bells, but you're back in the game! This is sure to help you get over the trauma and, best of all, it means we can celebrate the new year together! For that and everything else, let's (once again) put our cards on the table. We're (really) trying to thank you by giving you (after the Kwismas one) this New Year Gift:

 

	1 Hatter Mystery Box (to be used in DOFUS)
	1 Snow Bow Meow pet (to be used in DOFUS Touch)
	1 Mimi the Marvelous stuffed toy (to be used in WAKFU)
	1 season 3 Krosbox + 1 season 4 Krosbox (to be used in KROSMASTER)
	1 Gold Booster (to be used in KROSMAGA)


To get your gift, redeem the following code before 11AM (Paris Time) on Tuesday, January 3rd:

 
ANKAMA2017

All you have to do is copy and paste the code into the code page on the website to celebrate the arrival of 2017 in style! 

Do it now so you don't miss out on your gift!


And if you aren't familiar with our other games yet, what better occasion to start playing them?

 
"What about the double XP weekend, then?", you say? "Where is it?"
Well, we know exactly where it is!

It will take place next weekend: Saturday 7th and Sunday 8th January 2017.


After all, we did tell you this year would be perfect...

(That doesn't mean that it will be this year's theme... We're still hesitating between: "2017, the year of the red piwi", "2017, hear the gobballs scream" and "2017, get into the dungeon scene")


HAPPY NEW YEAR, EVERYONE!

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Advent Calendar!
notes.content:
Please note: This event runs on Paris time. Days will roll over at midnight Paris time, which is 6 PM Eastern Standard Time

Even better than a present. Even better than two presents! Even better than THREE presents! Even better than… Yes, okay, you got it: the DOFUS Advent Calendar with 25 surprises is coming out soon! Get ready to solve some riddles!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/4b3085af0909876404c899dbacb7eb4193a6717b.jpg

It's an annual tradition, on December 1st, the DOFUS Advent Calendar* arrives, packed with presents!*

The idea is simple: Every day, you have to solve a riddle. If you answer correctly, you get the present hiding under the illustrated box of the day! 

It's a different surprise every day, but each present can only be collected on the day that it is available, so if you want them all, you'll need to check back each day! And for those eager Christmas lovers who can't stay nestled snug in their beds, we will be giving a code for an additional present to all subscribed players who log in to the game between 12:01 AM and 6 AM (Eastern Standard Time) on December 25th.

Join us on December 1st for the start of the Advent Calendar!

*Only subscribed account can play the Advent Calendar.

notes.title: 5 Million Kama Field Dungeon Challenge!
notes.content:
This challenge is only available on Rushu, Rosal, Shika, Solar, and Zatoishwan.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/e7fbdfb14ef67a4dd86ebeb47538d1a3e4ca2ba4.jpg

Community Challenges are a game feature in DOFUS, that lets anyone and everyone offer a trial of sorts to their fellow players. Using the Community Challenge interface, one just has to decide on the conditions of the Challenge, the entry fee, the prize, the duration and/or maximum number of players that can successfully finish said Challenge, and see what happens. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/c91dcbf7f4750ca2587708931b8d3336274274c0.png

Should anyone fail, their entry fee reverts to the player who offered the challenge. So there's something in it for everyone, and they should only be attempted when one is sure to succeed.

With that in mind, we offer you the Field Dungeon Community Challenge!

Using a team of three or more players, all of level 40 or below, you must complete the Field Dungeon in Astrub. And everyone in your team must stay alive to reap the spoils of victory!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/0421d9f0fc5f065d212a15903a57ced0b9565420.png

Should you succeed, you will of course gain riches, in the form of kamas. This particular challenge has a 5 MILLION Kama event purse, which will be split evenly between all of the teams who successfully complete this challenge before it ends! And to make it even sweeter, all successful teams will also receive the prestigious Monarch Set, and the best prize of all...  bonds with the buddies who helped you through this ordeal. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26779124/261083a46b6f5319b3e5bdf3ae64cd6bc892150b.png

So, what are you waiting for? Go forth, to the Community Challenge Interface, accept the challenge and defeat the Famished Sunflower!

The Shika Challenge
The Zatoishwan Challenge
